name: Dara Sarasvati
bio:
Dara Sarasvati (born Dara Ayu Saraswati) is a prominent Indonesian content creator, actress, model, and cultural advocate widely known for popularizing traditional Indonesian clothing among Gen Z and global audiences. She shot to fame across TikTok and Instagram through her cinematic cultural videos, where she walks through public spaces in Yogyakarta and Bali dressed as traditional Indonesian mythological and historical figures like Roro Jonggrang, Ken Dedes, and Keong Mas.  She transitioned into mainstream acting, making her feature film debut in the movie Sayap-Sayap Patah 2: Olivia (2025).

Beyond entertainment, she manages her own beauty salon in Yogyakarta and handles business ventures under Khayangan House of Goddess and Darasvara Kreasi Semesta.
